mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, d.id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName FROM sys_user as u INNER JOIN sys_user_role_link as surl ON surl.user_id = u.id and u.bool_delete_enum = 0 and surl.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_department as d ON u.department_id = d.id and d.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE surl.role_id = #{roleId}
